author: Vox
description:
On January 24, 2023, Lindsay Clancy allegedly killed her three children — Callan, Dawson, and Cora Clancy — in a case that has now been brought to trial in Massachusetts. The trial is spurring conversations around postpartum psychosis, a very rare mental health condition that Clancy is claiming to have suffered from at the time of the killings.

Vox’s Today, Explained podcast talked to WBZ reporter Kristina Rex and psychiatrist Dr. Julia Nardi Riddle to get a better understanding of the case and its potential implications. Listen to the full episode wherever you get your podcasts. 

If you or someone you know is a new parent who’s struggling, you can call the National Maternal Mental Health Hotline at 833-TLC-MAMA (833-852-6262) any time.

author: Vox
description:
Gen Z protestors had a major win in India last week when they successfully forced one of Prime Minister Modi’s top advisors to resign. Driven by frustration over corruption, unemployment, and India’s education system, the Cockroach Janta Party (or the Cockroach People’s Party) is a satirical internet-fueled movement with real power. 

But their recent success has already driven Modi’s government to engage in more censorship and silencing of dissent. So what will the legacy of the Cockroach Janta Party be?

author: Vox
description:
In 2014, Narendra Modi pioneered the use of social media and digital campaigning in India to become prime minister. Known as one of the first global politicians to harness the power of the internet, he has the most social media followers of any world leader currently in office. 

Today, over a decade since Modi’s digital-first political campaign, an internet-fueled youth movement called the Cockroach Janta Party (or the Cockroach People’s Party) is using the same social media platforms to organize protests, successfully forcing the resignation of one of Prime Minister Modi’s top advisers. The Indian government has responded with a crackdown, arresting protesters and increasingly censoring X, Meta, and other social meda sites.
